question: What were the total sales in Q1 1999?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM atlas.dwd.store_sales AS store_sales INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.date_dim AS dim_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dim_date.d_date_sk WHERE dim_date.d_year = 1999 AND dim_date.d_qoy = 1 LIMIT 100
